cards.title: Glossary
items: G0.2: the coverage join; every declared entity must resolve to a ratified glossary term
G0.3: the confirmation join; every unit's confirmed_by must name a seat on the ratified roster (TC016)
Declaration: an input a door reads, required at ready so absence cannot pass
TC017: contract declares no entities; TC018: no ratified seat roster
TC003: a dependency is blocked; alone, or beside only declaration misses (TC017, TC018), it means parked, not invalid
TC004: a unit holds at most three acceptance sketches
TC007: intent must be 40-1200 chars; the skeleton's TODO intent trips it at both profiles, by design (ADR 0016)
Parked: a legal contract waiting on a blocked dependency; the audit reports it INFO at exit zero
Two-Key: a unit is done only when the Verifier re-runs the tests independently and grades PASS
ready-green: the contract passes the ready validation profile
Free path: a file outside the contract's scope that needs no scope entry (docs/, CHANGELOG.md)
Shipped surface: code, the schema, docs/, USAGE.md, CHANGELOG.md; the only prose that can fail a unit
